seo.title: Model · WG Service OS
seo.description: The WG Service OS model: a single system to control and execute after-sales service, end to end.

hero.subtitle: Service performance does not depend on isolated areas, but on how the system works as a whole. We structure service as one complete flow where every stage is connected, has a clear goal and directly contributes to the final outcome.

closing.lineOne: We do not manage parts of the service.
closing.lineTwo: We design the system so that the outcome is right.
